messages:
rachel-cs: Heads-up — HelixCare just ran into regional throttles during a partner demo. They asked for a short-term QPS increase and an IP allowlist for EU and APAC while onboarding completes. Opened case 795221. Need quick triage.

derek-net: What are the requested numbers and CIDRs?

rachel-cs: Case 795221. Request: EU -> 2500 qps (now ~700), APAC -> 1200 qps (now ~450). Window 36h. Egress prefixes: 52.47.120.0/22 and 18.64.0.0/18. Prefer routing to eu-west and apac-sin.

derek-net: I can push edge ACL L7 entries with TTL=129600s (36h). No peering needed for ephemeral. Will tag entries 'customer:helixcare' and schedule auto-expire.

omar-eng: Which route/model? Recommend setting max_concurrency=6, cap max_tokens=400 for the window, and enable prefix caching for their scripted demo prompts. Also configure fallback to llama-2-13b-q4.

rachel-cs: Route: hc-assistant-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4. HelixCare agrees to fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if capacity issues.

sofie-ops: Ticket 795221-allowlist created and assigned to derek-net. SLA 3h. I'll add Renewal Watch (renewal in 17 days) and CC AE.

derek-net: Applying L7 allowlist now. Plan: ephemeral rule, TTL=129600, map CIDRs to eu-west/apac-sin pools. Estimate apply ~2m.

ben-sales: FYI — demo is critical for renewal. Please capture any infra anomalies and paste smoke results to the case.

derek-net: Done — ACLs applied. Verified 200 from 52.47.121.9 hitting eu-west gateway. Auto-expire scheduled.

omar-eng: Ran a quick synthetic test under a 400qps pilot: p50 88ms, p95 360ms. No queueing seen. Enabled prefix cache and adjusted concurrency.

sofie-ops: Pasted smoke curl and perf snapshot to case. Example curl shared for customer: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"hc-assistant-prod","input":"ping","max_tokens":10}'
```

rachel-cs: Thanks team — informing HelixCare now and scheduling 15-min enablement run-through. Closing loop with sales afterwards.
